entries.heading: Funds
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 18111.  Funds 
appropriated by this title to the heading ``Department of Health and 
Human Services'' may be transferred to, and merged with, other 
appropriation accounts under the headings ``Centers for Disease Control 
and Prevention'', ``Public Health and Social Services Emergency Fund'', 
``Administration for Children and Families'', ``Administration for 
Community Living'', and ``National Institutes of Health'' to prevent, 
prepare for, and respond to coronavirus following consultation with the 
Office of Management and Budget:  Provided, 
That the Committees on Appropriations 
of the House of Representatives and the Senate shall be notified 10 days 
in advance of any such transfer:  Provided further, 
That, upon a determination that all or part of 
the funds transferred from an appropriation by this title are not 
necessary, such amounts may be transferred back to that appropriation:  
Provided further, That none of the funds made available by this title 
may be transferred pursuant to the authority in section 205 of division 
A of Public Law 116-94 or section 241(a) of the PHS Act.
